rules.title: Allowable annual rent increase, March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: The Rent Board's allowable annual rent increase for covered San Francisco units is 1.6% from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.citation: SF Rent Board, 571 Allowable Annual Increases
rules.extraction_note: This is a rates page. It does not state covered buildings, exemptions, the formula or penalties. Prior rates were 1.4% for 2025-26 and 1.7% for 2024-25.

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027, landlords must pay $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit. They must also pay an additional $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; $24,733 max per unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor children
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.coverage_text: Evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: Per the page, relocation for temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days is governed by Cal. Civ. Code 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance 37.9C. The page lists that rate as $446.00/day plus actual moving expenses per tenant household for notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27.
rules.extraction_note: The amounts apply by date of service of the eviction notice. The page does not list the permitted just causes, notice requirements or penalties.

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation payments
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act eviction notices served March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027, landlords must pay $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit. They must also pay an additional $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 max per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.extraction_note: The amounts apply by date of service of the eviction notice. The citation is inferred from the '578 Multilingual Relocation Payments 37.9A' label. The quoted span is a heading, not a full sentence.

rules.title: Security deposit interest rate, March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: The annual interest rate payable on security deposits is 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.citation: SF Rent Board, 572 Security Deposit Interest Rates
rules.extraction_note: This is an interest rate on deposits, not a maximum deposit amount. Its fit with the security_deposits category is uncertain. Prior rates were 5.0% for 2025-26 and 5.2% for 2024-25.
